original.Description: Point of view in a southwest direction - the moment of the Ukrainian strike on the Azot branch of Uralchem OJSC. Reportedly it is one of Russia's largest producers of nitrogen fertilizers and the country's sole supplier of several chemical products, including higher aliphatic amines, sodium nitrate, and crystalline sodium nitrite. The plant produces ammonia, urea, and ammonium nitrate, which are used, among other things, in the production of explosives.

original.Name: 11 SEP 2026
original.Description: A destroyed building, reportedly from the sanctioned Volgogradpromproekt plant, is visible on the premises of JSC Chimprom Volgograd following a reported Ukrainian missile attack. The Volgogradpromproekt plant is reportedly a Russian specialty chemical enterprise that produces organophosphorus compounds, flame retardants, resins, and other chemical components for industry. It is also reported that the company's products are used, in particular, in the aviation, shipbuilding, and special industries of the Russian Federation.
